subject: Any change in the Glimmer server?

messages.author: 3c5c46f91a95889d
messages.subject: Any change in the Glimmer server?
parts:
Dear,
The application http://glimmer.rstudio.com/campa/espectre3c/ that used to work perfectly, has stopped to work. I haven't updated the code neither any other change in the application. Last week it was working nicely but now it doesn't respond. I've restarted the session but nothing seems to change. The same code in my local computer works perfectly.

Has there been any change in the glimmer server? How to solve the problem?

All the comments are welcome,

All the best,

Campa,

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Any change in the Glimmer server?
parts:
Campa,

We are not aware of any changes on glimmer server (not to best of our knowledge).
I tried your app, and investigated to see if I can find any clues on why it is not working. I can see the R process starts up, but after 4-5 seconds it goes away. The application log file is also removed. The server log file does not show any error for this application.

In your local environment what version of Shiny package are you using? Can you post the output of sessionInfo() from your local environment?

One suggestion: You could deploy your current code that is working locally as a new application on Glimmer (just in case there are some subtle differences in the code). And see how that behaves. 
Or add some debugging comments/steps in the code to help with troubleshooting.

Sorry that can't be of more help at this point.

Fereshteh
